dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible series of irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the mid-to-lower lateral flank. Prominent structures exhibit a high-intensity white perimeter with a sharp gradient transition into darker, low-intensity interiors. Edges are non-uniform in thickness with jagged outer perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated on the anterior-dorsal region and near the base of the pectoral flipper. These clusters lack internal gradients and show high core pixel saturation.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent lateral annuli form an obtuse triangle in the mid-body region. A secondary chain of smaller high-intensity blobs forms a roughly linear geometric relationship extending posteriorly from the pectoral flipper.

other_distinctive_markers: Five distinct, elongated pectoral flipper claws with high contrast against the darker surrounding limb tissue.
